description: List perfumes that Parfumo members voted similar to a given perfume, perfumes suggested for layering with it, and reported dupes. Use for recommendations or cheaper alternatives. Returns three lists of perfumes with id and URL.

perfume.description: Perfume identifier: the `id` returned by other tools (e.g. "Dior/Sauvage_Eau_de_Toilette") or its Parfumo URL.

name: parfumo_get_similar_perfumes

DupeCandidate.description: One perfume reported as a dupe, with its vote count.

perfume.description: The perfume reported as a dupe.

votes.description: Number of members who reported it.

DupeGroup.description: One group of the dupes directory: an original and the perfumes reported as its dupes.

dupes.description: Perfumes reported as dupes of the original.

PerfumeSummary.description: A perfume as it appears in a listing (search, brand, ranking, similar).

concentration.description: Concentration or edition label shown next to the name (e.g. `Eau de Parfum`).

id.description: Stable identifier: `Brand/Perfume` URL slug, usable with every perfume tool.

p_id.description: Numeric Parfumo perfume id when the listing exposes it.

rank.description: Position in the ranking, when the listing is ranked.

rating.description: Average scent rating out of 10, when shown.

rating_count.description: Number of ratings behind `rating`, when shown.

reviews_count.description: Number of long reviews, when shown.

trend_count.description: Counter shown by trend rankings (collection adds, wishes or wears over the last 30 days).

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the perfume page.

SimilarPerfume.description: A perfume members voted as similar to (or good to layer with) another one.

id.description:
`Brand/Perfume` id. The site lists similar perfumes without links: only the first
entries are resolved; use `parfumo_search_perfumes` with name and brand for the others.

votes.description: Number of member votes (only for entries whose link was resolved).

dupes.description: Groups of Parfumo's dupes directory in which this perfume appears, as original or as dupe.

layering.description: Perfumes members suggest layering with this one.

perfume_id.description: `Brand/Perfume` id of the perfume the lists refer to.

similar.description: Perfumes voted as similar by members, strongest consensus first.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems: optional parts that could not be loaded.
